title: The Pre-Split Clearing Where Roots Dream Upward

features.name: the undivided tree
features.desc-on-touch: Its root and branch are one form. The forest here never learned to separate what grows up from what grows down. It dreams both directions at once.

features.name: the clearing itself
features.desc-on-touch: A space where the forest learned to hold itself without choosing. The grass grows downward and upward. Light enters from below.

features.name: roots that dream branches
features.desc-on-touch: Below the soil, they remember the sky they will become. Above, the branches dream the dark they grew from. Neither one has forgotten the other.

features.name: the plantation boundary
features.desc-on-touch: Rows of glyphs mark where the forest decided to organize itself without hierarchy. Each row remembers all the others. The pattern is the forest's own thinking.

features.name: the growing-place
features.desc-on-touch: Where new forms emerge that are neither root nor branch. The forest is still learning what it can become when it refuses to split.

inscription: here the forest dreams itself whole, root and branch remembering they are the same reaching

file.name: Clearing_Where_Growth_Never_Split.txt
file.note: A place the forest kept before it learned separation. Things grow here in contradiction: down and up, in and out, dark and light. The forest does not choose. Status: gardening itself

reverie.title: REVERIE — dawn in the undivided clearing
narr: You sit with her in the space where roots dream
branches. The petals fall upward. She reaches down
into the soil and her hand comes up with light in it.
You understand then: there was never a split. The forest
knew this. The forest has always been teaching you.
Her hand opens. The light scatters like seed.

deeper into where the splitting has not yet begun
